source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 截图散点区域颜色占比估计分布，并生成示例点；不能恢复重叠样本
provenance.en: Synthetic observations sampled from a distribution estimated from screenshot color occupancy. Counts and boxplot statistics are not original.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 每个 genome 的唯一编号、物种/类别和 BGC 数量。
基因组筛选规则、BGC 检测方法/版本，以及一条记录代表的独立观测单位。
KDE 带宽、箱线图 whisker 规则，以及是否包含异常值。
en: Unique genome ID, species/group and BGC count per genome.
Genome inclusion criteria, BGC-calling method/version and the independent observation unit.
KDE bandwidth, boxplot whisker convention and outlier policy.

preprocessing.zh: 每行对应一个 genome 的 BGC 计数，代码从 value 计算 KDE 与箱线统计；jitter 只是水平排点偏移。
preprocessing.en: Each row is a genome BGC count. KDE and box statistics are computed from value; jitter is only a horizontal display offset.

description.zh: 实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.zh: 单个观测值；单位及归一化见本图原始数据要求
description.en: One observation; units/normalization are specified in this figure’s raw-data requirements

description.zh: 只控制散点水平偏移；可省略
